title: Salvianolic Acid B Enhances Motor Function Recovery after Spinal Cord Injury in Association with AKT/mTOR/HIF-1alpha Pathway Activation and Angiogenesis.
authors: Yao, Jiange; Chen, Yingfeng; Pan, Fengjun; Zhang, Susu
one_liner_zh: 研究丹酚酸B通过AKT/mTOR/HIF-1α通路促进脊髓损伤恢复，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Spinal cord injury (SCI) is a devastating condition with limited treatment options. Salvianolic acid B (SalB), a natural compound from Salvia miltiorrhiza, shows therapeutic potential, but its mechanisms in SCI remain unclear. This study integrated network pharmacology and experimental validation to investigate the effects of SalB. We combined network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo experiments using a rat SCI model, and applied the AKT inhibitor Capivasertib (AZD5363) for mechanistic verification. Network analysis identified 188 SalB-SCI common targets primarily in the AKT pathway, and molecular docking predicted strong binding between SalB and AKT1. In rats, SalB improved motor function, reduced tissue damage, and enhanced neuronal survival in association with activation of the AKT/mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR)/hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) axis and promoted angiogenesis, while these effects were reversed by AZD5363. Collectively, our findings demonstrate that SalB treatment is associated with activation of the AKT/mTOR/HIF-1alpha pathway and enhanced angiogenesis, which correlate with improved functional recovery after SCI. These results provide experimental evidence for the multi-target reparative mechanisms of SalB and highlight its promise as a therapeutic intervention for SCI.
abstract_zh: 脊髓损伤（SCI）是一种破坏性疾病，治疗选择有限。丹参酚酸B（SalB）是从丹参中提取的天然化合物，显示出治疗潜力，但其在SCI中的作用机制尚不清楚。本研究整合了网络药理学和实验验证，以探讨SalB的作用。我们结合网络药理学、分子对接以及使用大鼠SCI模型的体内实验，并应用AKT抑制剂Capivasertib（AZD5363）进行机制验证。网络分析识别出188个SalB-SCI共同靶点，主要集中于AKT通路，分子对接预测SalB与AKT1之间存在强结合。在大鼠中，SalB改善了运动功能，减少了组织损伤，并增强了神经元存活，这与AKT/哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白（mTOR）/缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α）轴的激活及促进血管生成相关，而这些效应被AZD5363逆转。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，SalB治疗与AKT/mTOR/HIF-1α通路的激活及血管生成的增强相关，这些与SCI后功能恢复的改善相关联。这些结果为SalB的多靶点修复机制提供了实验证据，并凸显了其作为SCI治疗干预手段的潜力。
